user.title: Connect to ElevenLabs
user.description: Enter an ElevenLabs API key. The key needs write access to Conversational AI. Nothing is saved until you choose an agent on the next screen.

data_description.api_key: Create a key in the ElevenLabs dashboard, under your profile. Give it write access to ElevenAgents.

agent.title: Choose an agent
agent.description: These are the agents this API key can reach. The chosen agent receives the tools that read and control the entities you select later.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new API key
reauth_confirm.description: The stored API key no longer works. It may have been revoked, or its permissions may have changed. The agent and the webhook stay as they are.

duplicate.title: This agent already has tools with these names
duplicate.description:
This agent already has a tool called ha_call_service or ha_get_state. Two tools with the same name make the agent choose unpredictably.

This integration did not create that one, so it is not touched without your say-so. Detaching leaves it in your ElevenLabs workspace, where you can attach it again at any time.

error.invalid_auth: ElevenLabs rejected this key. Check that you copied it whole, and that it has not been revoked.
error.insufficient_scope: This key works, but it may not reach Conversational AI. Open the key in the ElevenLabs dashboard and give it write access to ElevenAgents.
error.no_agents: This key reaches no agents. Create an agent in the ElevenLabs dashboard first, then add this integration again.
error.agent_not_found: This agent no longer exists in the workspace this key reaches.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach ElevenLabs. Check this machine's internet connection and try again.
error.rotation_unsynced: ElevenLabs could not be updated. The change was not confirmed; try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log holds the detail.

abort.already_configured: This agent is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new API key works. The integration is connected again.
abort.no_external_url: Home Assistant has no external URL, so ElevenLabs cannot reach it. Set an external URL under Settings > System > Network, then add this integration again.

create_entry.default:
Your key and your agent are stored.

Nothing is exposed yet. **[Choose what your agent may see and do]({panel_url})** — until you do, the agent can reach nothing in this installation.

init.title: Manage this agent's access
init.description: These settings control what the agent can read, what it can do, and how the webhook is protected.

read.title: Choose what the agent can read
read.description: Pick entities and areas. Everything selected here, and everything selected for control, can be read.

control.title: Choose what the agent can control
control.description: Pick entities and areas. The next screen shows exactly what this grants before it is saved.

granted.title: Confirm what this grants
granted.description:
Nothing is saved until you submit this screen. Leaving now discards the selection you just made.

{granted}

exceptions.title: Remove specific actions
exceptions.description: Every controlled entity is listed below with its services, all selected. Clear the ones the agent must not perform.

auto_expose.title: Automatic exposure
auto_expose.description: New entities that register on a device already inside your selection can join by themselves. Reading and control are separate choices, and both start off. An entity that registers while Home Assistant is restarting, or while this integration is not loaded, is missed for good.

rotate_secret.title: Rotate the shared secret
rotate_secret.description: Generates a new webhook secret and sends it to ElevenLabs immediately. The old secret stops working the moment this completes.

rotate_webhook.title: Rotate the webhook id
rotate_webhook.description: Registers a new webhook path, moves the agent's tools to it, then removes the old path. Confirm to continue.

timeout.title: Confirmation timeout
timeout.description: Home Assistant waits this many seconds for a device to confirm an action before reporting it unconfirmed. It must stay below the tool's response timeout in the ElevenLabs dashboard.

error.timeout_not_below_agent: This must be lower than the tool's response timeout in the ElevenLabs dashboard, or Home Assistant will never get to report the outcome.
error.rotation_unsynced: ElevenLabs could not be updated. The change was not confirmed; try again.

confirm.title: Require authentication on this agent
confirm.description:
This agent has no authentication, so anyone who learns its identifier can talk to it, spend your ElevenLabs credit, and use the entities you exposed. Home Assistant will require a signed link from callers. Your other agent settings are left alone.

Read this first: if you also reach this agent from an embedded web widget, that widget stops working until it is changed to request a signed link of its own.

timeout_crossed.title: The two timeouts now cross
timeout_crossed.description:
The agent's timeout is lower than Home Assistant's, so it closes the connection before the answer arrives. Home Assistant waits up to {confirm_timeout} seconds for a device to confirm; the agent gives up after {agent_timeout}.

Fix it in either place: lower the confirmation timeout in this integration's options, or raise the tool's response timeout in the ElevenLabs dashboard. This notice clears itself once the first number is below the second.

rotation_unsynced.title: The new value did not reach ElevenLabs
rotation_unsynced.description: The webhook credential was changed here, but ElevenLabs could not be updated, so the agent is still sending the old one. Run the synchronise action again, or open the integration's options and repeat the change. This notice clears itself once a synchronisation succeeds.

sync_tools.name: Synchronise tools
sync_tools.description: Write the tool definitions for the selected entities into the ElevenLabs workspace and attach them to the agent.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: The ElevenLabs Agent config entry to synchronise.
